description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the JsonInternalVisitor implementation by constructing a sample JSON object, converting it using the visitor, and asserting the result matches the expected JSON string.

classes.name: JsonInternalVisitorTest
classes.description: Test class for JsonInternalVisitor, implementing methods to convert JSON values to string representation.

methods.name: nullValue
methods.description: Returns string representation for null JSON value.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Converts a boolean value to its string representation.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Converts a string to a JSON-formatted string, escaping quotes.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Converts a JsonNumber to its string form.

methods.name: array
methods.description: Converts a stream of string values to a JSON array string.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Converts a stream of map entries (key-value pairs) to a JSON object string.

methods.name: testJsonInternalVisitor
methods.description: Unit test validating the JSON visitor's ability to produce expected JSON string output.
